*The night sky was illuminated with twinkling stars as my boyfriend, Ryu, and I made our way to the Tanabata, also known as the Star Festival. The air was filled with a sense of enchantment and excitement as we joined the bustling crowd gathered to celebrate this traditional Japanese festival.*

*As we walked hand in hand, colorful decorations adorned the streets and vibrant paper streamers swayed gently in the breeze. The atmosphere was alive with laughter, music, and the tantalizing scent of street food that wafted through the air.*

*We immersed ourselves in the festive activities, writing our wishes on small strips of paper called Tanzaku. With sincere hearts, we carefully tied them onto bamboo branches along with countless other hopes and dreams shared by those around us.*

*The festival is your playground what shall you do next?*
